events.title: Elvis Presley: 49 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we lost a true icon. Elvis Presley's impact on music and culture is still felt around the world. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, an event that led to his death six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, the music world was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. His legacy continues to influence generations.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Walk This Way
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous ever, but what's your top track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders. What's your favourite song from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: Imagine (UK Single) Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message is as relevant as ever.

events.title: iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Tech That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it dropped and changed everything about listening to music on the go. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today we celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to thrilling gadgets, what's your favourite Bond film or moment?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His songs still resonate today.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse and experimental record. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Landmark Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed their sound in new directions. What are your top picks from it?
